purpose: Grant the API runtime the minimal subject-account and display-name columns required by the authenticated Workbench bootstrap.
lockImpact: Catalog-only GRANT operations take short permission metadata locks; no application table data or definitions are changed.
dataImpact: No rows are changed. ai_crm_runtime gains only three workforce account columns and four workforce profile columns used by the reviewed bootstrap path.
backfill: Not required. The privilege change is effective for new statements.
recovery: If the bootstrap composition is withdrawn, append a reviewed migration that revokes these exact column grants and workforce_access schema usage after confirming no remaining API path consumes them.
forwardFix: Append a later globally numbered migration to narrow, revoke, or add a specifically reviewed privilege. Never rewrite this migration after application.
